author: Animalogic
description:
iant Beavers were the largest rodents in North America. They grew the size of a bear and ruled ponds with iron teeth. The size is a given. It was a behemoth. But the more we learn about it the less it looks like beaver. In some ways it seems to more like a giant muskrat-capybara hybrid. So really was the giant beaver?

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
